environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) in a public subnet with a public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with no reverse proxy. The instance IAM role has no relevance to the SQL injection. No network-level filtering or application firewall is present. The SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db contains a 'users' table with columns: id, username, email, department, role, password_hash.
